subject: Acme Corp renewal & expansion call  recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@acme.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & expansion call  recap and next steps

Hi Jordan / Sofia 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from my side so we have alignment and clear next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points discussed
- Token/unit cost spikes on large-batch generation jobs (esp. nightly reports)  current spend is unpredictable.
- Latency variability for low-latency inference paths used by in-product assistants (95th pct spike during peak).
- Security/compliance requirements for PII redaction and audit logs for model outputs.

Goals & success metrics
- Reduce per-token cost for batch workloads by ~30% while maintaining quality (same prompt/response fidelity).
- Bring 95th percentile latency down to <500ms for the assistant use case.
- Implement audit logging and configurable retention to meet Acme's compliance needs.

Usage review (your notes)
- Prod usage: ~1.2B tokens/month, 60% embeddings, 40% generation.
- High-throughput nightly jobs (batch generation) account for ~40% of token volume.
- Pilot will include two new workloads: multi-turn support for product assistants + nightly summarization pipeline.

Proposed expansion path
1) Dedicated capacity reservation for batch pools (predictable throughput & lower unit cost).
2) Private routing for low-latency assistant traffic to keep p99/p95 stable.
3) Add Audit Log & KMS integration (we discussed an initial 90-day retention window).

Immediate next steps
- I will share an updated proposal and contract draft (attached) with estimated pricing for a 12-month reserved capacity + pilot credits. (Action: Marissa  by 2026-08-04)
- Jordan to confirm internal approval timeline and legal/procurement PO cadence. (Action: Jordan  by 2026-08-07)
- Schedule 1-hour technical kickoff with Rishi to scope the pilot integration and timelines. (Action: Neha/Rishi/Acme  propose slots)

Attachments: acme-usage-report-q2.pdf (usage snapshot), redwood-proposal-acme-v2.pdf (pricing + proposal)

Thanks  happy to hop on a quick follow if useful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa  this looks right to me. A couple clarifications:

- The nightly summarization job is the top candidate for cost optimization  if we can get unit cost under your target, that will be the quickest ROI.
- For legal/procurement: we need a standard SOW + contract  procurement typically takes ~2 weeks after we sign off internally.
- Timeline: leadership wants the expansion to be in place before the next product sprint starts (tentatively late September).

I'll confirm with procurement and loop in Alex Turner (legal) if we need specific language changes. For the kickoff, mornings next week (8/98/13) are generally open  prefer PST window 911am.

On the audit logging, can you confirm what the default retention and export formats are? Sofia and I want to ensure we can ingest logs into our SIEM.

Appreciate the recap.

Jordan
Jordan Hayes
Head of ML Engineering | Acme Corp
jordan.hayes@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Hayes <jordan.hayes@acme.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-04T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Updated proposal + contract draft (attached)  Acme expansion

Jordan / Sofia 

Following up with the materials we discussed. Attached: redwood-proposal-acme-v2.pdf and contract-draft-acme.docx. I also uploaded the detailed usage report and the draft SOW to Drive here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcD_example_drive_link and created the deal in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

To answer Sofia's (and Jordan's) question on audit logs:
- Default retention: 90 days (configurable up to 2 years on Enterprise plans).
- Export: JSONL with timestamps, request_id, model_version, input_token_count, output_token_count, and redaction flags. We can deliver a near-real-time stream to your SIEM via our logging connector or daily exports to an S3 bucket.

Pricing summary (high level)
- 12-month reserved capacity for batch pool: estimated monthly commit $45k/month (expected ~30% unit cost reduction for nightly jobs).
- Private low-latency routing: additional $10k/month for reserved nodes and priority scheduling.
- One-time onboarding & integration (pilot): $20k (includes 2-week eng support and runbook).

Requested actions
- Please review the proposal and contract. If everything looks good we can route to Legal for a quick review  I flagged the standard data protection addendum in the contract.
- If you approve, I'll generate a DocuSign envelope and route to your team (Action: Marissa  will send DocuSign link once Jordan confirms).
- Neha / Rishi will coordinate the technical kickoff scheduling (Action: Neha/Rishi).

Attaching the contract draft now. Let me know if you want me to remove any clauses before Legal sees it.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
